channel.title: RealHunt: new homes
channel.description: New homes on RealHunt, checked by a person and scored from 70 to 98.

item.title: €109,000 · Three-bedroom village house with a vine-covered terrace and sea views in Messinia
item.description: Vasilitsi, Messinia. 116 m². RealHunt score 93. A 116 m² two-storey house in Vasilitsi, at the southern tip of the Messinian peninsula, with views over the sea and the hills: three bedrooms, two kitchens, two living rooms and two bathrooms, a covered veranda and a vine-shaded terrace with blue railings, plus a roof terrace with views of the sea and mountains. Air conditioning, double glazing and wooden floors. Memi and Ammoudi beaches are about 3 km away. Asking €109,000, about €940/m².

item.title: €158,000 · Stone-and-beam Tuscan home with a 70 m² terrace and high-end finishes
item.description: Roccastrada, Grosseto, Tuscany. 220 m². RealHunt score 85. A single-family home free on three sides in Roccastrada, in the Grosseto hills, finished with high-quality materials: exposed stone walls, wooden beam ceilings, oak floors and a big arched window, a spacious living room, a glass-walled kitchen and two bedrooms over two floors. A large terrace of about 70 m² and a big garage. The Tuscan sea is about 40 minutes away. Asking €158,000, about €718/m².

item.title: €150,000 · Medieval-village house with a terrace above a sea of clouds in Tuscany
item.description: Svizzera Pesciatina, near Pescia, Tuscany. 148 m². RealHunt score 85. A 148 m² townhouse on four levels in a medieval hamlet of the 'Svizzera Pesciatina', a few kilometres from Pescia: a guest flat with its own entrance, a panoramic room with a fireplace, a kitchen, living room and bedroom, and on top a bedroom, bathroom and a terrace with views over wooded valleys, often filled with morning mist. New heating (LPG, pellet and wood). Lucca, Pisa and Florence are within reach. Asking €150,000, about €1,014/m².

item.title: €160,000 · Sea-view villa with two covered verandas 1 km from Vignola beach
item.description: Baia Vignola, Aglientu, Sardinia. 86 m². RealHunt score 81. An end-of-terrace villa in the Baia Vignola residential complex in north Sardinia, with a splendid sea view: a bright living room with a kitchenette, a master bedroom, a second small bedroom and a shower room, plus two large covered verandas, one facing the sea for lunches and dinners in the breeze, and a private garden. Parking space in the complex. The village of Vignola Mare and its crystal-clear beaches are 1 km away. Asking €160,000, about €1,860/m².

item.title: €97,000 · Renovated granite stazzo with flower boxes in a Sardinian village
item.description: Luras, Gallura, Sardinia. 70 m². RealHunt score 80. A traditional Gallurese stazzo in the historic centre of Luras, northern Sardinia, restored with respect for its exposed granite, wood and iron: a living room with an open kitchen around a big fireplace, a reed-and-beam ceiling, bold colours and pop touches, a double bedroom, a second bedroom, two bathrooms and an attic. Flower boxes on the stone façade, and the Costa Smeralda beaches about 40 minutes away. Asking €97,000, about €1,386/m².

item.title: €151,000 · The historic Savage House: a white Victorian with a gingerbread porch
item.description: Scotland Neck, North Carolina. 199 m². RealHunt score 90. Step into the charm of the historic Savage House, a beautiful 1900 Victorian in Scotland Neck, North Carolina: 2,143 sq ft (199 m²) with three bedrooms and two bathrooms, gingerbread trim, a front porch reached by a brick path, high ceilings and freshly finished interiors with wood floors, on a large shaded lot. Asking $169,900 (about €151,000), about €759/m².

item.title: €159,100 · Adirondack farmhouse on 10.8 acres of autumn forest
item.description: Forestport, Adirondack foothills, New York. 147 m². RealHunt score 85. Forestport Adirondack foothills retreat on 10.8 acres: a 1918 farmhouse of 1,577 sq ft (147 m²) with three bedrooms, a renovated grey kitchen with butcher-block counters, a dining room, a living room with a stone accent wall and an enclosed sun porch, surrounded by maple forest that turns red and gold every October. Asking $179,000 (about €159,100), about €1,082/m².

item.title: €155,500 · Charming 1952 Cape Cod with fall colours on a 1.1-acre lot
item.description: LaVale, Maryland (Allegheny Mountains). 174 m². RealHunt score 88. Charm, space and a great setting: a 1952 three-bedroom Cape Cod on 1.1 acres in LaVale, in the Allegheny Mountains of western Maryland, with 1,868 sq ft (174 m²), hardwood floors, a wooden staircase, bright freshly painted rooms, a full basement and a big lawn framed by trees that blaze orange in autumn. Asking $175,000 (about €155,500), about €894/m².

item.title: €155,500 · Brand-new 2024 log cabin surrounded by farmland in Kentucky
item.description: Elk Horn, Kentucky. 114 m². RealHunt score 83. A beautiful 2024 log cabin on a 1-acre lot surrounded by farmland in Elk Horn, Kentucky: 1,224 sq ft (114 m²) with a cathedral wood ceiling, a sage-green kitchen with a farmhouse sink and stainless appliances, hardwood floors, two bedrooms, a modern tiled bathroom and a covered front porch. The lot is part of a 29-acre tract. Asking $175,000 (about €155,500), about €1,364/m².

item.title: €173,300 · Lake-country home with a wood stove, deck and pool near Big Wolf Lake
item.description: Big Wolf Lake, Lewiston, Michigan. 144 m². RealHunt score 88. A charming three-bedroom, two-bathroom home on Big Wolf Lake Road in Lewiston, northern Michigan: 1,545 sq ft (144 m²) with a pine-ceiling living room and wood stove, a colourful dining room, a kitchen with stainless appliances, a covered front porch, a deck with an above-ground pool and 0.9 acres of pines. Lakes, trails and golf all around. Asking $195,000 (about €173,300), about €1,203/m².

item.title: €150,000 · Stone island house with blue doors and a sea view over to Skiathos
item.description: Glossa, Skopelos (Sporades). 110 m². RealHunt score 89. A 110 m² stone maisonette in Paleo Klima, Glossa, on the Mamma Mia island of Skopelos, with an open, unobstructed view of the Aegean and Skiathos. Bright blue shutters and doors, wooden beamed ceilings, a traditional fireplace corner, a sunny kitchen-living room and two bedrooms over two levels. Close to the main road with easy access, and sold ready to move into. Asking €150,000, about €1,364/m².

item.title: €158,000 · Furnished Cretan house with a shared pool for just four homes
item.description: Drapanos, Apokoronas, Crete. 76 m². RealHunt score 87. Villa Dionysos: a fully furnished 76 m² two-bedroom house over two floors in a small, quiet complex in Drapanos, near Chania. A bright open-plan living room with a corner sofa and fireplace opens onto a covered private terrace; the kitchen and dining area look out over the pool, shared by only four houses and backed by open countryside. Upstairs, two double bedrooms, each with its own terrace, the master with sea views. Asking €158,000, about €2,079/m².

item.title: €115,000 · Whitewashed Cretan village house with a roof terrace and spiral stairs
item.description: Choumeriako, near Neapoli, Crete. 93 m². RealHunt score 91. A renovated 93 m² detached house in the traditional village of Choumeriako, 3 km from Neapoli and 13 km from the beaches of Agios Nikolaos. Downstairs, a modern kitchen, two bedrooms and a bathroom with a corner bath; a spiral staircase leads up to a lovely sitting room with a wood stove that opens onto a big terrace with umbrellas and views over the village. Stone arches, wooden beams and whitewashed walls keep its old character. Asking €115,000, about €1,237/m².

item.title: €158,000 · Hillside house with a sea-view veranda 1 km from Porto Ottiolu beach
item.description: Ludduì, Budoni, Sardinia. 64 m². RealHunt score 80. A two-level terraced house in the peaceful hillside hamlet of Ludduì, Budoni, with an exclusive view of the Sardinian sea: a bright living room with an open kitchen and a spiral staircase, opening onto a covered veranda for dining with the sea on the horizon; upstairs, a master bedroom with its own courtyard, a second bedroom and a bathroom. 1 km from the golden beach and marina of Porto Ottiolu and 2.5 km from Budoni. Asking €158,000, about €2,469/m².

item.title: €95,000 · Fairy-tale house with a gazebo and stone BBQ in the Pelion forest
item.description: Chania, Pelion (near Portaria). 68 m². RealHunt score 88. Surrounded by towering trees in the mountain village of Chania in Pelion, a 68 m² single-family house renovated in 2021 on a 213 m² corner plot: a wood-lined living room with a fireplace, a bedroom with its own fireplace, a modern kitchen, a bathroom and a small veranda, plus a 29 m² basement, two storerooms, a built-in stone BBQ and a large covered gazebo in a green garden. Sold with furniture and three inverter air conditioners. Asking €95,000, about €1,397/m².

item.title: €120,000 · Wooden island-style house with a BBQ terrace hanging over the Pagasetic Gulf
item.description: Trikeri, Pelion. 54 m². RealHunt score 83. In the cobbled, island-like village of Trikeri at the tip of Pelion, a 54 m² house on two levels: a carefully renovated wooden studio with a high ceiling, a loft with a double bed, kitchen, dining area and bathroom, opening onto a big covered terrace with a wood oven, a BBQ and a fantastic view of the sea. Below, a separate 15 m² studio with its own kitchen and shower. Sleeps six; use it as one house or two holiday flats. Asking €120,000, about €2,222/m².

item.title: €164,400 · Riverfront house on French Island with views of the Penobscot
item.description: French Island, Old Town, Maine. 117 m². RealHunt score 85. A 1,258 sq ft (117 m²) three-bedroom home on historic French Island in Old Town, Maine, with stunning views of the Penobscot River right from the yard: a standing-seam metal roof, a fresh kitchen, a bright living room and a lot that runs down to the water. Bangor and the University of Maine are minutes away. Asking $185,000 (about €164,400), about €1,405/m².

item.title: €159,100 · Scandinavian-style log cabin with a stone fireplace on 10 acres
item.description: Saxon, Wisconsin (Lake Superior region). 133 m². RealHunt score 85. A large custom-built Scandinavian-style log cabin from 1998 on a quiet country road in Saxon, Wisconsin, near Lake Superior: 1,430 sq ft (133 m²) with full log walls, a fieldstone hearth with a wood stove, a breakfast bar, three bedrooms, a log staircase to the loft and a green metal roof, on 10 acres of woods. Asking $179,000 (about €159,100), about €1,196/m².

item.title: €158,000 · Summer cottage on a 980 m² garden plot 2 km from the beach
item.description: Marathopolis, near Gargaliani, Messinia. 62 m². RealHunt score 82. A 62 m² house on a flat plot of 980 m² among olive trees and just a few neighbours, near Marathopolis: a sitting area with a wood stove, an open kitchen, a bedroom and a shower room downstairs, and a wooden staircase up to an attic with a balcony and extra beds. A garden with paths, a storeroom and a built-in BBQ. 2 km to Lagouvardos beach, 15 minutes to Gialova and its golf courses, 25 to Pylos. Asking €158,000, about €2,548/m².

item.title: €155,000 · Modern, furnished two-bedroom house near the sea on Rhodes
item.description: Paradeisi, Rhodes. 84 m². RealHunt score 85. An 84 m² detached house in Paradeisi on Rhodes, in very good condition, modern, bright and sold furnished: a stylish kitchen with a breakfast bar and pendant lights, a living room, two bedrooms and a bathroom. Air conditioning, a solar water heater, aluminium frames and tiled floors, with no shared expenses. Close to the sea, shops, cafés and the island's airport. Asking €155,000, about €1,845/m².

item.title: €137,700 · Gambrel-roof cabin with a wrap porch and fire pit in the Allegheny forest
item.description: Tionesta, Allegheny National Forest, Pennsylvania. 94 m². RealHunt score 85. 'The best cabin weekends start with: who's coming?' A 1986 gambrel-roof cabin on 0.6 acres in Tionesta, on the edge of the Allegheny National Forest: 1,013 sq ft (94 m²) with a wrap-around porch, a knotty-pine kitchen and dining room, a cosy living room with a gas heater, two bedrooms plus a bunk loft, and a fire pit with benches in the yard. Asking $154,900 (about €137,700), about €1,465/m².

item.title: €177,700 · Log cabin at Canadohta Lake with a duck pond out front
item.description: Canadohta Lake, Union City, Pennsylvania. 93 m². RealHunt score 82. A two-bedroom log cabin at Canadohta Lake in northwest Pennsylvania, with a pond and ducks right in front: about 1,000 sq ft (93 m²) with a wood-panelled living room, a kitchen with granite counters and stainless appliances, a loft, a bathroom with laundry, a wrap-around porch, a picnic area and a green metal roof. A short walk to the lake for boating, swimming and ice fishing. Asking $200,000 (about €177,700), about €1,911/m².

item.title: €159,000 · Cosy mountain townhouse near the Abetone ski slopes, sold furnished
item.description: Cutigliano, Pistoia mountains, Tuscany. 127 m². RealHunt score 82. A 127 m² terraced house free on three sides in the centre of Cutigliano, a few kilometres from the ski slopes of Doganaccia and Abetone: a large beamed living room with a fireplace and parquet, a kitchen with a wood-fired grill, a utility room, three bedrooms and a bathroom, plus a partly usable attic. In very good condition, with efficient systems, and sold furnished. Price negotiable. Asking €159,000, about €1,252/m².

item.title: €160,000 · Renovated Umbrian country home with an annexe, vines and an orchard
item.description: Città della Pieve, Umbria. 114 m². RealHunt score 81. A finely renovated 90 m² home over three floors in the small Valdilucciole hamlet near Città della Pieve, plus a 24 m² annexe with a living/sleeping area: beamed ceilings, a living room with a pellet stove, a kitchen, two bathrooms and three bedrooms with countryside views. A fenced garden and orchard with olive, peach, pear, fig and plum trees and a row of table grapes. New roof in 2015 and double-glazed wooden windows. Asking €160,000, about €1,404/m².

item.title: €139,000 · Tuscan cottage with an olive-tree garden 5 minutes from Saturnia hot springs
item.description: Montemerano, Maremma, Tuscany. 76 m². RealHunt score 76. An independent house with a corner garden and a beautiful olive tree in Montemerano, one of the Most Beautiful Villages in Italy, in the hills of the Tuscan Maremma: a living room with a kitchenette, two well-kept bedrooms with spectacular views and a bathroom, plus a 24 m² garage underneath. Panoramic position and its own entrance; the famous Saturnia hot springs are just 5 minutes by car. Price recently reduced. Asking €139,000, about €1,829/m².

item.title: €159,990 · Brand-new 2025 cottage with a pergola deck 400 m from the sea in Halkidiki
item.description: Kallikrateia, Halkidiki. 72 m². RealHunt score 84. A new-build 72 m² house from 2025 in Kallikrateia, Halkidiki, energy class A and sold furnished: three bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen and three bathrooms, with a big wooden pergola deck, string lights for summer evenings, a garden with banana plants, parking, A/C, double glazing and a BBQ. The sea is 400 m away and Thessaloniki airport about 45 km. Asking €159,990, about €2,222/m².

item.title: €142,200 · Well-kept A-frame on 2.5 acres in Michigan's Upper Peninsula
item.description: Kenton, Upper Peninsula, Michigan. 102 m². RealHunt score 83. Just outside Kenton, in the Ottawa National Forest area of Michigan's Upper Peninsula, a well-kept 1984 A-frame on 2.49 acres: 1,097 sq ft (102 m²) with three bedrooms, a kitchen with an island, a vaulted wood-panelled loft, a sunroom looking onto the woods, a deck and a fire pit. Snowmobile and ATV trails start nearby. Asking $160,000 (about €142,200), about €1,394/m².

item.title: €140,000 · Stylish renovated flat with a fireplace and terrace in Montaione, Tuscany
item.description: Montaione, Tuscany (between Florence and Pisa). 78 m². RealHunt score 79. A three-room first-floor home with a fully independent entrance in the quiet Mura area of Montaione, carefully renovated in 2019: a spacious living room with a fireplace opening onto a private terrace, a modern kitchen with a wooden table and pendant lights, two bright bedrooms and a bathroom with a window. Below, a private courtyard and a cellar with a laundry corner. In the hills between Florence, Pisa and Siena. Asking €140,000, about €1,795/m².

item.title: €129,000 · Ground-floor home with terraces and a communal pool on the Condado de Alhama golf resort
item.description: Condado de Alhama, Alhama de Murcia (about 35 min from Murcia and Cartagena). 106 m². RealHunt score 87. A 106 m² ground-floor home in the quiet gated Condado de Alhama resort, next to the golf course: a bright living room with an open, fully fitted kitchen, two double bedrooms and a single, a bathroom, and two private terraces with a pergola and a small garden. Sold furnished and in move-in condition, with air conditioning, a private parking space, a communal pool set in palm gardens and children's play areas. East-facing for light all day. Murcia and Cartagena are each about 35 minutes away. Asking €129,000, about €1,217/m².

item.title: €149,950 · Five-bedroom village house in move-in condition with a roof terrace and solar panels
item.description: Hondón de los Frailes, Alicante (about 25 min from Elche). 180 m². RealHunt score 88. A roomy 180 m² townhouse in the very heart of Hondón de los Frailes, steps from shops, bars and services, in excellent move-in condition: a modern living room with a wood-burning fireplace, a fitted kitchen with a dining area, five bedrooms and two bathrooms. Central heating, air conditioning, solar panels and a private roof terrace / solarium with village and mountain views, plus a patio of about 60 m². Ideal for a big family or to mix own use with holiday letting. Elche is about 25 minutes by car. Asking €149,950, about €833/m².

item.title: €135,000 · Never-lived-in ground-floor flat with a communal pool in Albatera
item.description: Albatera, Alicante (about 22 min from Elche). 139 m². RealHunt score 88. A spacious 139 m² ground-floor flat in a modern 2006 building in a quiet part of Albatera, never lived in and fully step-free with a ramp at the entrance: three large bedrooms, two full bathrooms (one en suite), a bright living-dining room opening onto a balcony, and a fully equipped kitchen with its own access to the balcony. Wooden floors, ducted air conditioning already installed and a parking space with direct access from the garage to the flat. Communal pool with a lawn. Supermarkets, shops and schools are close by; Elche is about 22 minutes away. Asking €135,000, about €971/m².

item.title: €145,000 · Spacious 150 m² three-bedroom flat with a lift and parking in Bigastro
item.description: Central Bigastro, Alicante (about 25 min from Murcia). 150 m². RealHunt score 86. A generous 150 m² flat in the heart of Bigastro, close to shops, schools and green areas: a living room opening onto a balcony, a separate dining area, a modern dark-wood kitchen with gas hob and built-in oven, three large bedrooms with fitted wardrobes and two full bathrooms, one en suite with a bathtub. Air conditioning, a laundry, a lift and a parking space. Well kept and ready to move into. Orihuela is next door and Murcia about 25 minutes away. Asking €145,000, about €967/m².

item.title: €138,000 · Fully renovated stone house with beams and a fireplace near Valladolid
item.description: Velliza, Valladolid (about 25 min from Valladolid). 124 m². RealHunt score 87. A characterful 124 m² house with thick stone walls in the village of Velliza, about 20 km from Valladolid. Completely renovated, including floors, doors, bathrooms and windows, with exposed beams and stone throughout. Downstairs, a large living-dining room with a fireplace, an office-style kitchen, a bathroom and direct access to the garage; upstairs, a spacious sitting room now used as a bedroom, two more bedrooms and a full bathroom. New pellet-stove heating plus electric radiators. No garden or patio. Valladolid is about 25 minutes by car. Asking €138,000, about €1,113/m².

item.title: €119,000 · Fully renovated three-bedroom townhouse with a two-car garage in Colomera
item.description: Barrio Alto, Colomera, Granada (about 35 min from Granada). 228 m². RealHunt score 91. A 228 m² townhouse in the Barrio Alto of Colomera, renovated top to bottom with a sleek white finish: an open, fully fitted kitchen flowing into a large living-dining room, a bathroom and a laundry area downstairs, and a small patio garden off the living room. Upstairs, three bright bedrooms and a full bathroom; on the top floor, a big extra room for a studio, playroom or fourth bedroom, plus a rooftop terrace with a pergola. Garage for two cars and heat-pump air conditioning. Move-in ready; Granada is about 35 minutes away. Asking €119,000, about €522/m².

item.title: €145,000 · Single-storey house with a private pool on a 1,000 m² plot near Seville
item.description: Urbanización El Cuzco, Los Palacios y Villafranca, Seville (about 25 min from Seville). 120 m². RealHunt score 87. A fully fenced plot of about 1,000 m² in a small, quiet gated residential estate in Los Palacios, right by the AP-4 to Seville. The main house is single-storey and in good condition, with no damp or cracks: a living-dining room with a fireplace and an open fitted kitchen, three bedrooms and a full bathroom, plus a front porch looking onto an 8.2 x 5 m swimming pool in impeccable condition. Also a pump room with a toilet, a double storeroom with a summer kitchen, parking for several cars and an orchard with fruit trees. About 120 m² built as listed. Seville is about 25 minutes away. Asking €145,000, about €1,208/m².

item.title: €91,000 · Fully renovated three-bedroom house with an 80 m² roof terrace in Alzira
item.description: Alquerieta, Alzira, Valencia (about 35 min from Valencia). 113 m². RealHunt score 87. A 113 m² house in the Alquerieta area of Alzira, fully renovated from the wiring and plumbing to the floors, doors, windows, kitchen and bathrooms. Downstairs, a large living-dining room open to a smart white kitchen with access to a big patio with a laundry area, plus a full bathroom; upstairs, three good bedrooms and a second bathroom with a glass shower. On top, a private roof terrace of about 80 m². Marble-look floors and a bright modern finish throughout. Valencia is about 35 minutes by car. Asking €91,000, about €805/m².

item.title: €116,900 · Brand-new four-bedroom flat of 135 m² in Agualada, Galicia
item.description: Agualada, Coristanco, A Coruña (about 35 min from A Coruña). 135 m². RealHunt score 86. A brand-new, never-lived-in 135 m² flat (117 m² usable) on the first floor in Agualada, Coristanco: a 29 m² open-plan kitchen, dining and living space with a breakfast bar and fitted appliances, four generous bedrooms (18.9, 16.5, 16.3 and 12 m²), a 9 m² shower room and a storeroom. Double-glazed aluminium windows, laminate floors and an electric water heater; no lift. 1.3 km from the motorway; Carballo is 12 km away and A Coruña about 35 minutes by car. Asking €116,900, about €866/m².

item.title: €149,000 · Premium townhouse fully renovated in 2025 in Jijona
item.description: Jijona / Xixona, Alicante (about 25 min from Alicante). 232 m². RealHunt score 88. A 232 m² townhouse just off the main street of Jijona, completely renovated in 2025 to a premium standard and never lived in since: new plumbing and wiring, a replaced roof with a big skylight that floods the staircase with light, PVC double glazing, marble-look porcelain floors and black wrought-iron balconies. Seven split levels: a kitchen-diner with a wine fridge and a storeroom, a living-dining room, four bedrooms and two full bathrooms, one with a freestanding tub. East-facing, steps from the Barranco park, the new library and public parking. Alicante is about 25 minutes by car. Asking €149,000, about €642/m².

item.title: €80,000 · Three-bedroom flat with a full high-spec renovation in Utrera
item.description: El Tinte, Utrera, Seville (about 25 min from Seville). 102 m². RealHunt score 88. A 102 m² flat in the El Tinte area of Utrera, renovated throughout with high-quality materials: new wiring and plumbing, marble-look floors, recessed lighting, a modern kitchen with built-in oven and microwave, a bright living room, three bedrooms with fitted wardrobes and a stylish bathroom, plus a laundry area. Nothing to do but move in. Seville is about 25 minutes by car or train. Asking €80,000, about €784/m².

item.title: €144,997 · Move-in ready three-bedroom ground-floor home with its own entrance in San Isidro
item.description: San Isidro, Alicante (about 16 min from Elche). 152 m². RealHunt score 87. A ground-floor home in San Isidro with its own independent entrance, ready to enjoy from day one: 96 m² usable (152 m² built as listed) with a large living-dining room, a long fitted kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms, plus a terrace with planters, a laundry, a storeroom and a garage parking space. Sold furnished, with air conditioning and heating. No painters and no renovation budget needed. Elche is about 16 minutes away. Asking €144,997, about €954/m².
